scope: Stage diagnostics rerun only on Train/Dev. Test statistics use immutable saved predictions, never Test-conditioned model inputs. No training or changed model/evaluation artifacts.

base.policyValidation: Generated economic Dev total loss only; no public-component retention criterion.

large.policyValidation: Generated economic Dev total loss only; no public-component retention criterion.

no_value.policyValidation: Generated economic Dev total loss only; no public-component retention criterion.

findings.finding: Public tool skill regresses during research-only policy fine-tuning.
findings.evidence: Identical 494 inputs and fixed pretrained revisions; base native Dev exact drops 20/32 to 2/32, large 11/32 to 7/32, no_value 20/32 to 1/32. Native and expanded Train also regress. Non-demand weights between language and final are updated only in policy training.

findings.finding: Research extraction labels overwrite shared mode/state/recovery behavior.
findings.evidence: Base Dev observable argument modes change from span 21/choice 5 to compute 11/missing 8/span 6/choice 1. no_value changes to compute 21/missing 5. Span/choice/use weights remain exactly unchanged while shared encoder/fusion and mode/state/recovery change.

findings.finding: An unsupervised tool parameter state gates otherwise observable argument values.
findings.evidence: ABCD loss adapters supervise use/mode/pointers/choices but not parameter state. Policy final base blocks eight of 26 observable Dev fields as unavailable; large blocks nine. Bypassing the state gate raises latent value matches from 3 to 5 in base and 15 to 19 in large, but tool-and-arguments exact remains 2/32 and 7/32 because selection is still wrong.

findings.finding: Compound Test exact accuracy primarily reflects failed tool selection and concentration on one tool.
findings.evidence: Large selects seven correct tools out of 26 calls, all pull-up-account. All seven observable correct tool outputs have correct arguments. Base selects one correct tool and fails its arguments. no_value has one success with zero arguments.

findings.finding: Generic action candidates include actions outside the requested tool interaction.
findings.evidence: Large saved Test calls include eight answer and two hold outputs. The ABCD request permits a spoken response or a tool call. Removing answer/hold in label-independent Dev probes alone does not improve full exact accuracy.

findings.finding: Initial retrieval budget hides a small number of annotated defaults.
findings.evidence: Native Dev has 24/26 observable arguments available as spans or enums in round zero; both absent arguments are n/a in the same verify-identity case and exist elsewhere in public policy. This cannot explain the 20-to-2 stage regression with identical inputs.

repairPriority: Protect public-language capability during policy learning with balanced replay of source-annotated public tasks and structured field examples; retain encoder learning under those mixed objectives.

Select policy checkpoints with both economic Dev loss and per-component Dev retention, and report before/after checkpoints. Use the preserved common language checkpoints rather than repeating unaffected training.

Constrain actions and extraction modes by public task/tool schema. Do not gate tool values with a state head whose corresponding tool states were never supervised; retain explicit missing/conflict and confirmation behavior.
Report tool recall, tool selection, argument accuracy conditional on correct tool, arity-stratified exact match, and macro results by tool; preserve existing final Test artifacts.
